title: America the Beautiful — Our Blessed Land
memory_verse: "For the LORD your God is bringing you into a good land." — Deuteronomy 8:7 (NIV)
objective: Students will learn about America's beautiful land and give thanks to God for our country.
content: America is a beautiful country! We have tall mountains, wide rivers, green forests, and golden fields. God made it all!
There is a song called 'America the Beautiful' that talks about our purple mountains and amber waves of grain. These are the beautiful things God put in our land.
From the Atlantic Ocean on one side to the Pacific Ocean on the other side, America is filled with God's creation — deserts, lakes, meadows, and beaches!
We should thank God every day for giving us such a beautiful country to live in. 'God shed His grace on thee' — that means God has blessed America!
activity: Draw a picture of America the Beautiful! Include mountains, rivers, trees, and fields. Color everything bright and beautiful. Write 'God Bless America' at the top of your picture.
discussion: What beautiful things did God put in America?
What are the two oceans on each side of America?
How can we thank God for our beautiful country?
